name: prototype
description: Builds throwaway code to answer a design question before committing to architecture: a logic facet (an interactive terminal app over a portable state model) and a UI facet (radically different visual variants on one route).

medium.title: Rendered-view medium
medium.description: Preferred medium for this plugin's rendered views. auto uses each skill's shipped default. terminal, file, and artifact select that rung of the rendered-views ladder. An unrecognized value is reported and treated as unset.
